title: Dynasty Trade Activity: weekly player and draft-pick trade counts from real dynasty fantasy football leagues
description:
Weekly counts of how often each player and draft pick was traded in real dynasty fantasy football leagues, by format (all leagues, superflex, 1QB), from March 2, 2026. Published by Dynasty Dealer. The files are updated every week on GitHub; each version here is a citable snapshot.

Three tables: players_weekly (trades, distinct leagues and share of all trades, per player), picks_weekly (per pick season and round) and market_weekly (weekly totals). Source: completed trades in Sleeper leagues of the dynasty type, read from Sleeper's public API. Rows need at least 5 trades in their week and format.

Counts only: no player values, no trade-by-trade rows, no league or manager identifiers.

Dynasty Dealer is not affiliated with or endorsed by Sleeper.
